title: 軟硬複合電路板
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究彎曲應變、材料與剛柔交界；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate bending strain, materials and rigid-flex transitions. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

stages.title: 機構與層疊
stages.description: 以三個技術單元逐一建立「機構與層疊」的模型和可反駁的驗證證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units build models and falsifiable verification evidence for mechanics and stackup.

steps.title: 固定與動態彎曲：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Static versus dynamic flex: model and design
steps.objective: 以「固定與動態彎曲」建立可檢驗的模型，明確標出座標、變數、單位和有效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable model for static versus dynamic flex, stating coordinates, variables, units and validity bounds.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅的概念示範，再排列本單元的元件、能量或資料路徑。裝配時彎一次與使用中反覆彎曲需要不同壽命要求。 畫出基準與改變一個參數後的兩個狀態；用「明確列出預計彎曲次數與角度分布。」提出可被推翻的預測。另列未量測條件，勿把動畫位置當真實尺寸。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor concept demonstration, then arrange this unit’s components, energy or data paths. One-time installation bends and repeated operational flexing need different life requirements. Draw baseline and one-parameter-changed states. Form a falsifiable prediction using: List expected bend count and angle distribution. List unmeasured conditions; animation positions are not physical dimensions.
steps.check: 提交「固定與動態彎曲」兩狀態圖、變數單位表和預期差異；以本步判別方法說明何種結果會推翻模型。
steps.checkEn: Submit two states, a variable/unit table and predicted differences for static versus dynamic flex; specify which diagnostic result would falsify the model.
steps.observation: 明確列出預計彎曲次數與角度分布。
steps.observationEn: List expected bend count and angle distribution.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：可折一次就表示可無限次動態彎折。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: One successful bend proves unlimited dynamic flex. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

knowledge.titleEn: Course quantitative model and validity limits
knowledge.text: 簡化彎曲應變 ε≈y/R；均質對稱薄片外表面 y≈t/2。 小應變幾何近似，不是銅疲勞壽命或允許彎曲半徑規格。

steps.title: 固定與動態彎曲：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: Static versus dynamic flex: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 以「固定與動態彎曲」區分可能失效機制，提出可追溯的判讀與交付證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate failure mechanisms in static versus dynamic flex, with traceable interpretation and evidence.
steps.instruction: 保留前一步模型，檢查它能否解釋觀察。明確列出預計彎曲次數與角度分布。 記錄原始量、基準、重複性與單位；比較正確機制「裝配時彎一次與使用中反覆彎曲需要不同壽命要求。」和待排除假說「可折一次就表示可無限次動態彎折。」。最後作出接受、重測或修正模型的決定，並列出資料不能支持的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the preceding model and check whether it explains observations. List expected bend count and angle distribution. Record raw values, reference, repeatability and units. Compare the supported mechanism “One-time installation bends and repeated operational flexing need different life requirements.” with the hypothesis to reject “One successful bend proves unlimited dynamic flex.”. Decide to accept, repeat or revise and state what the data cannot establish.
steps.check: 交付判別表與證據：明確列出預計彎曲次數與角度分布。 附上不確定度或未知量、反例及接受／重測理由。
steps.checkEn: Deliver a discrimination table and evidence: List expected bend count and angle distribution. Include uncertainty or unknowns, a counterexample and acceptance/retest rationale.
steps.observation: 明確列出預計彎曲次數與角度分布。
steps.observationEn: List expected bend count and angle distribution.
steps.failure: 待排除的錯誤主張：可折一次就表示可無限次動態彎折。 若模型與資料不符，先查參考面、單位與假設，再用本步的獨立量測區分原因。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect claim to reject: One successful bend proves unlimited dynamic flex. If model and data disagree, check reference planes, units and assumptions before using this step’s independent diagnostic.

在彎曲區增加尖角能分散應力。
以轉換截面估算銅層到中性軸距離。
optionsEn: A multilayer neutral axis is always at the geometric center.
Sharp corners in a bend distribute stress.
Estimate copper-to-neutral-axis distance using a transformed section.
quiz.explanation: 不同彈性模數和厚度使中性軸偏離幾何中心。 以轉換截面估算銅層到中性軸距離。
quiz.explanationEn: Different moduli and thicknesses shift the neutral axis from geometric center. Estimate copper-to-neutral-axis distance using a transformed section.
